extracted.intended_audience: fiction writers, literary critics, and creative-writing students
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for writing and evaluating realist fiction prose, emphasizing point of view, precise detail, and techniques that create believable consciousnesses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Free Indirect Style
rubrics_metrics.description: The prose technique where third-person narration takes on the voice, vocabulary, and consciousness of a character without explicit 'he thought' markers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: "When I talk about free indirect style I am really talking about point of view." It is the distinctive achievement of the modern novel; it integrates character interiority into the narrative voice and allows the narrator to convey a character's consciousness without overt signals.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Real
rubrics_metrics.description: Fiction's job is to render 'lifeness' — the sense of a real consciousness perceiving a real world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wood treats 'the real' as the fundamental aim of fiction — the bottom of his inquiries. Work should convince readers of an authentic perceiving mind and an instantiated world rather than merely narrating events or ideas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Primacy of Detail / Thisness
rubrics_metrics.description: Use precise, irreducible detail (haecceitas, 'thisness') to make a fictional world particular and alive.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Generic detail kills fiction; 'thisness' sustains it. The choice of specific, individuating details both vivifies the world and tells the reader about the consciousness that noticed them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Character Aliveness
rubrics_metrics.description: Characters become alive through precise observation rendered through their consciousness rather than through explicit psychological exposition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid 'psychology lectures' about characters. Effective prose keeps 'an unsentimental composure and knows how to withdraw, like a good valet, from superfluous commentary.' Show character via perceptions and the selectivity of what they notice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commercial Realism
rubrics_metrics.description: Attend to mundane, everyday life — the breakfast table, the office, the bus — as legitimate material for fiction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Capturing the banal alongside the significant often produces more authentic representation than pursuing the sublime alone; attention to ordinary detail grounds realism.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hysterical Realism (negative criterion)
rubrics_metrics.description: A critique of certain contemporary big novels characterized by excesses that undermine 'the real.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Symptoms to avoid: manic, cartoonish characters; frenzied, improbable action; information-overload prose; length without depth; a vitality that is 'not life' but its 'imitation.' These are anti-patterns that prevent convincing depiction of consciousness and world.

rubrics_metrics.name: Flaubert's Legacy
rubrics_metrics.description: The modern realist mode established after Flaubert: invisible authorial presence, meticulous visual noticing, and the use of free indirect style.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: "There really is a time before Flaubert and a time after him." Emulate an unobtrusive authorial stance and exact visual attention to detail to achieve modern realism.

rubrics_metrics.name: Detail's Two Powers (Vivifying and Selecting)
rubrics_metrics.description: Details both bring the fictional world to specific life (vivifying) and imply a consciousness that has chosen this detail and not another (selecting).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use detail not only to describe but to reveal the perceiver: vivifying details make scenes concrete; selective details indicate the character's attention, values, and perspective.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluative Criteria for Success
rubrics_metrics.description: A concise list of what makes a passage of fiction succeed according to Wood.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A passage succeeds when: it convinces us of a perceiving consciousness; its details have 'thisness,' not generality; its voice integrates character interiority via free indirect style; it withdraws from over-commentary; it avoids hysterical excess.
